title: Nexus: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Nexus failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If Nexus progress feels unfair, slow down. Scan again, remove valuable cargo, repair gear, and treat the next interaction as a test with a clean exit.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If Nexus progress feels random, stop activating new objects. Scan again, empty valuables, prepare counters, and repeat a smaller test near an exit.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
